scope: Own component build, two native automation tests, saved map reload, new PIE property readbacks, one inspected PIE frame and fresh post-migration ground traversal passed. See separate verification limits.

build.scope: Native project build, not a packaged game

tests.name: CityLab.Tunnel.ProfileAndLifecycle
coverage: Default half extents and non-colliding, non-overlap, non-navigation, non-ticking settings
Immediate ConfigureTunnel profile changes and readonly extent display
FObjectWriter/FObjectReader roundtrip followed by PostLoad; not a disk package-load test
Reflected editor property change callback updates extents
Invalid, nonfinite, negative and excessive dimensions are sanitized

tests.name: CityLab.Tunnel.WaterRegistrationAndTransform
coverage: Real ShaderWorld WaterSubsystem with a controlled flat-water provider; no rendered ocean
Native registration contributes exactly one shape/group
Seven probes inside/outside a rotated, translated and scaled volume
Seven corresponding probes with mirrored negative scale; positive packed half extents
Moving the owning actor moves the excluded area
Runtime ConfigureTunnel shrink updates water membership without duplicate shapes
Unregister removes the exclusion and restores provider water coverage

native_automation.scope_limit: Water query and shape lifecycle checks under NullRHI. They do not verify the actual ocean material or GPU wave rendering.

map_integration.reload_method: Scene.load_level of the saved map, separate from the automation archive/PostLoad test
map_integration.scope: Native property reads in editor, reloaded editor map and newly started PIE; not a manual Blueprint click-through or rendered-ocean test.
